title: Dual Phospho-CyTOF Workflows for Comparative JAK/STAT Signaling Analysis
author: Ilyssa E. Ramos
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare thawing media
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL thawing media immediately before use and discard leftovers.

substeps.instruction: Mix 44.495 mL RPMI 1640 GlutaMAX (89 %), 5.000 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (10 %), 0.500 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (1 %), and 0.005 mL Pierce Universal nuclease (10 000×) to a final volume of 50 mL.
Warm the media in a 37 °C water bath before thawing PBMCs.

steps.title: Prepare cisplatin labeling media
steps.instruction: Create 500 mL cisplatin labeling media, filter‑sterilize, store at 4 °C, and warm before use.

substeps.instruction: Combine 495 mL RPMI 1640 GlutaMAX (99 %) with 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (1 %).
Filter through a 0.22 µm, 500 mL filtration unit.
Store up to 1 month at 4 °C; warm in a 37 °C water bath before labeling.

steps.title: Make 2× Cell‑ID Cisplatin working solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of 2× Cell‑ID Cisplatin‑195 Pt working solution immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.005 mL (2 000×) Cell‑ID Cisplatin‑195 Pt to 9.995 mL RPMI 1640 GlutaMAX.
Discard any remaining solution after labeling is complete.

steps.title: Prepare stimulation media
steps.instruction: Formulate 500 mL stimulation media, filter‑sterilize, store at 4 °C for up to one month.

substeps.instruction: Mix 445 mL RPMI 1640 GlutaMAX (89 %), 50 mL heat‑inactivated FBS (10 %), and 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (1 %).
Filter through a 0.22 µm, 500 mL filtration unit.

steps.title: Prepare 1× thaw/lyse buffer
steps.instruction: Generate 50 mL 1× thaw/lyse buffer, filter‑sterilize, and store at room temperature for up to one month.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.05 mL 1 000× thaw/lyse concentrate to 49.95 mL molecular‑biology grade water.
Filter through a 0.22 µm, 500 mL filtration unit.

steps.title: Prepare 1× barcoding buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL 1× barcoding (BC) buffer and store at 4 °C for up to one month.

substeps.instruction: Combine 45 mL MaxPar PBS with 5 mL 10× barcode perm concentrate.

steps.title: Prepare iridium intercalation solution
steps.instruction: Assemble 4 mL iridium intercalation solution immediately before use and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3.998 mL Maxpar fix and perm buffer with 0.002 mL Cell‑ID Intercalator‑Ir (12.5 µM, 2 000×).
Aliquot the stock after thawing; discard any second‑thaw aliquots.

steps.title: Prepare 1:10 EQ4 bead suspension
steps.instruction: Create 10 mL of 1:10 EQ Four Element bead solution in CAS+ immediately before use and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 9 mL Maxpar cell acquisition solution plus for CyTOF XT (CAS +) with 1 mL 10× EQ Four Element calibration beads.
Vigorously shake by hand for ≥30 s; do not vortex.

steps.title: Make 5× stimulation stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 5× cytokine stocks for whole blood and cPBMCs, aliquot into matrix tubes, and freeze at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Label 1.5–2.0 mL Eppendorf tubes according to Table 1 (UNS, IFNα, IFNγ, LPS, IL‑21).
For each stimulant, combine the volumes shown in Table 2 (e.g., IFNα: 47.847 µL IFNα stock + 1 952.153 µL cRPMI to total 2 000 µL).
Aliquot 50 µL of each 5× stock into the corresponding matrix tube for whole blood; freeze at –80 °C.
Aliquot 25 µL of each 5× stock into wells of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate for cPBMC stimulation.

steps.title: Incubate cPBMC stimulation plates
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well V‑bottom plate containing 5× stocks at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until cPBMCs are ready.

steps.title: Whole blood stimulation and fixation
steps.instruction: Stimulate, fix, and optionally freeze whole blood samples in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Rest heparinized whole blood tubes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 30 min–1 h.
Thaw required matrix tubes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for ~20 min.
Aliquot 200 µL whole blood into each matrix tube containing 5× stimulant; mix quickly, changing tips between wells.
Incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Add 250 µL 1× Prot1 (Proteomic Stabilizer) to each tube in the same order as blood addition; mix, changing tips.
Incubate 10 min at room temperature.
Proceed to whole‑blood lysis (Section D) or freeze at –80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: cPBMC thaw, cisplatin label, and rest
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved PBMCs, label viability with cisplatin, and rest before stimulation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cPBMC vials to dry ice, then thaw in a 37 °C water bath for 2 min.
Transfer 1 mL cells to a pre‑labeled 14 mL round‑bottom tube; wash the cryovial with 1 mL thawing media and add to the same tube.
Centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min, RT; aspirate supernatant.
Wash with 10 mL pre‑warmed cisplatin labeling media; centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min, RT; aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL pre‑warmed cisplatin labeling media; count cells.
Centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min, RT; aspirate.
Resuspend at 2 × 10⁷ cells/mL in cisplatin labeling media.
Add an equal volume of 2× Cell‑ID Cisplatin‑195 Pt working solution (e.g., 1 mL to 1 mL).
Incubate 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Quench with 5 × volume of pre‑warmed cRPMI (e.g., add 10 mL to 2 mL cell suspension).
Centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min, RT; aspirate.
Add 10 mL cRPMI, mix gently; centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min, RT; aspirate.
Resuspend in 10 mL cRPMI and rest 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: cPBMC stimulation and fixation
steps.instruction: Stimulate rested cPBMCs with cytokines, fix with formaldehyde, and prepare for downstream processing.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 25 µL of each 5× stimulant into wells of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; pre‑warm at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Resuspend rested cells to 2 × 10⁷ cells/mL; transfer 100 µL into each corresponding well of a 96‑well V‑bottom assay plate.
Add 25 µL of the appropriate stimulant to each well; mix by pipetting up/down.
Incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
≈55 s before the end, add 20 µL 16 % formaldehyde (methanol‑free) to each well (final 2.2 % w/v).
Mix thoroughly; incubate 10 min at 25 °C, 350 rpm on a thermomixer.
Add 100 µL cold 1× BC buffer to each well.

steps.title: Whole blood lysis (up to three rounds)
steps.instruction: Lyse fixed whole blood, wash, and transfer cells to a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.

substeps.instruction: Thaw matrix tubes at 25 °C water for 15 min.
Transfer 500 µL stimulated/fixed whole blood into a 2 mL deep‑well plate containing 1.2 mL 1× thaw‑lyse buffer.
Mix with a P1200 multichannel pipette; lyse 10 min at RT.
Centrifuge 548 × g, 10 min, RT; remove supernatant.
Seal plate, vortex gently, add 1.6 mL 1× thaw/lyse; mix and lyse 10 min at RT.
Centrifuge 548 × g, 10 min, RT; remove supernatant.
Seal and vortex; if RBCs remain, repeat the 1.6 mL thaw/lyse step (max three lysis cycles).
If no RBCs remain, wash pellet with 1.6 mL cell staining buffer (CSB).
Centrifuge 974 × g, 10 min, 4 °C; remove supernatant leaving ~50 µL.
Resuspend with 100 µL CSB, transfer to corresponding wells of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.
Centrifuge 974 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; remove supernatant.
If any liquid remains in the deep‑well plate, transfer it to the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare barcodes (optional)
steps.instruction: Resuspend barcode ampules in BC buffer and keep on ice until use.

substeps.instruction: Thaw required barcode ampules from the 20‑plex Pd kit on wet ice.
For cPBMCs add 30 µL barcode per well; for whole blood add 50 µL per well (based on plate layout).
Resuspend each ampule with 100 µL 1× BC buffer.
Transfer each resuspended barcode to a single well of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; avoid placing two identical barcodes in the same well.
Store the barcode plate at 4 °C until needed.

steps.title: Barcode cells (optional)
steps.instruction: Apply barcodes to lysed whole‑blood or cPBMC samples in a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well V‑bottom plate 974 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; flick off supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 µL ice‑cold 1× BC buffer; centrifuge 974 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; flick off supernatant.
Resuspend each well in 50 µL barcode (whole blood) or 30 µL barcode (cPBMC).
Incubate 30 min at 25 °C, 350 rpm on a thermomixer.
Add ice‑cold 1× BC buffer to bring volume to 200 µL per well; centrifuge 974 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; flick off supernatant.
Resuspend in 100 µL CSB, pool up to 20 barcoded samples into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Rinse each original well with 100 µL CSB and pool into a second 2 mL tube.
Centrifuge all tubes 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend primary pellet in 500 µL CSB, combine with wash pellet, and bring total volume to 2 mL with CSB.
Centrifuge 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Adjust final volume to 50 µL per barcoded sample (e.g., 750 µL for 15 barcodes).

steps.title: Surface staining & methanol permeabilization
steps.instruction: Stain barcoded cells with surface antibody master mix, fix, and permeabilize with methanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 2× surface master mix (Table 3) to each 2 mL Eppendorf tube containing barcoded cells.
Incubate 30 min at 25 °C, 350 rpm on a thermomixer.
Centrifuge 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB; centrifuge 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant. Repeat once more.
Add 800 µL ice‑cold 100 % MeOH dropwise, then an additional 1 mL 100 % MeOH dropwise.
Incubate on ice 30 min.
Pause point: store samples at –80 °C in 100 % MeOH (up to 4–6 weeks).

steps.title: Intracellular staining & iridium intercalation
steps.instruction: Stain permeabilized cells with intracellular antibodies and intercalate iridium.

substeps.instruction: Thaw tubes from –80 °C on wet ice for 30 min.
Centrifuge 1 000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB; centrifuge 1 000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant. Repeat once.
Measure residual volume; add CSB to reach 50 µL per barcode (e.g., 750 µL for 15 barcodes).
Add 2× intracellular master mix (Table 4) at 50 µL per barcode; incubate 30 min at 25 °C, 350 rpm.
Centrifuge 1 000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 1.8 mL CSB; centrifuge 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant. Repeat once.
Resuspend each tube in 100 µL iridium intercalation solution; store at 4 °C ≥30 min (max overnight).

steps.title: Prepare samples for Helios acquisition
steps.instruction: Wash cells, resuspend in CAS + with EQ4 beads, and load onto the Helios CyTOF.

substeps.instruction: Start Helios: plasma (≈20 min), install nebulizer (2–5 min), background check (1–2 min), tune (≈16 min), run EQ4 beads (≈2 min), run CAS + buffer ≥15 min to pre‑condition injector.
Retrieve each 2 mL tube, vortex, and add CSB to 1.8 mL total volume.
Centrifuge 1 000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant, leaving ~50 µL.
Repeat the wash (steps above) once more; keep ~50 µL per tube.
Resuspend cells in 1.8 mL CAS +; centrifuge 1 000 × g, 10 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend again in 1.8 mL CAS +; repeat centrifugation.
Add 1 mL freshly prepared 1:10 EQ4 beads (in CAS +); keep on ice.
Take 10 µL for counting with a C‑Chip hemocytometer; adjust cell concentration to 1.3 × 10⁶ cells/mL in the EQ4‑CAS + mixture (aim for 350–400 events/s).
Load samples onto the Helios and acquire data.
